title: Optimization Review Questionnaire
lede: Fielded at the first optimization review and on every review thereafter. Its job is to establish what actually moved, what caused it, and whether the value promised at signature is being realised — in a form that survives contact with a sceptical executive.

meta.Output: Optimization readout + findings backlog + renewal signal

questions.text: Review date
Which review is this?
options: Ad hoc, triggered by an issue

questions.text: Measurement window — From: ____  ·  To: ____
questions.logic: RingCentral Business Analytics serves 184 days of history. A window longer than that cannot be measured directly and must be assembled from stored run snapshots — say which was used.

questions.text: Who is in the room?
questions.logic: "Nobody from the business side" on a third review is itself a finding. Optimization that only IT attends is optimization nobody is acting on.

questions.text: Has the primary contact changed since the last review?
RingEX users — Licensed: ____  ·  Activated: ____  ·  Active in the window: ____
questions.logic: Pre-filled by the agent from inventory. The human's job is to explain any gap, not to recount it.

questions.text: RingCX agents — Licensed: ____  ·  Active: ____  ·  Never logged in: ____
Is the rollout complete?
Where has each product landed?
questions.logic: "Deployed but unused" is the most valuable answer on this page — it is paid-for capability producing nothing, and it is the easiest value to recover.

questions.text: Has the desk-phone estate changed as expected?
What is the main reason any part of the rollout is not where it was expected to be?
Answer rate — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
questions.logic: Inbound only, measured as answered ÷ (answered + notAnswered) from Business Analytics with groupBy Company. If the baseline used a different denominator, this is a definition change rather than a movement — flag it in O2.9.

questions.text: Missed call rate — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
Average speed to answer — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
Average handle time — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
questions.logic: Reference only. A rise can mean worse efficiency or deeper service, and the readout should not claim either without O2.10.

questions.text: Outbound connect rate — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
RingCX queue answer rate — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____  ·  Date measured: ____
questions.logic: Without WEM, RingCX queue figures come from realTimeData and describe today only, not the window. Record the date measured, and never present a same-day figure as a window result.

questions.text: AI insight coverage of recordings — Baseline: ____  ·  Current: ____
blanks: AI insight coverage of recordings — Baseline

questions.text: Where did the current figures come from?
questions.logic: Anything below platform-native carries the same provenance caveat as the post-SOW baseline. A current figure measured less rigorously than the baseline cannot be claimed as an improvement. Business Analytics and Call Log are different data sources and will not reconcile — a blended figure is not a measurement.

questions.text: Did any metric definition change between the baseline and now?
questions.logic: A changed definition invalidates the movement. It is not a failure to report it; it is a failure to report it late.

questions.text: For any metric that moved materially, what change caused it? (Links to O3.)
Is the measurement window long enough to support rate-based claims?
options: No, the window is too thin
questions.logic: Where the answer is anything but "yes", the readout presents counts and configuration findings and explicitly re-baselines the rates. This matches how the agent flags the same condition.

questions.text: Since the last review — Findings raised: ____  ·  Actioned: ____  ·  Deferred: ____  ·  Won't-do: ____
questions.logic: The actioned-over-raised ratio is the single clearest signal of whether the optimization loop is actually running or just producing reports.
blanks: Since the last review — Findings raised

questions.text: Status of the highest-priority findings by layer.
questions.logic: "Blocked (customer)" is a renewal-risk flag as much as a delivery one — it means value is being withheld by something outside our control, and it belongs in O6.

questions.text: Have the compliance findings been closed?
questions.logic: Emergency-address gaps are not volume-dependent and do not improve on their own. An open RAY BAUM'S Act finding at a second review is an escalation, not a backlog item.

questions.text: What was the single highest-impact change made this period, and what did it move?
Overall layered score vs. last review:
Licence position — Seats billed: ____  ·  Seats active: ____  ·  Seats reclaimed this period: ____
questions.logic: The most defensible value claim in the program, because both sides of it are counted rather than estimated.

questions.text: Has any cost been removed as a result of this platform?
What has been retired — lines, hardware, a parallel tool, a contract?
Has anyone's job measurably changed for the better?
What value was expected at signature that has not yet appeared, and why?
questions.logic: The question most likely to be skipped and most likely to predict a difficult renewal. Ask it even when the review is going well.

questions.text: How satisfied is the business with the platform? (1–5)
How satisfied is IT with administering it? (1–5)
How satisfied are front-line users? (1–5)
What is the most common complaint you hear?
options: Something is hard to find or do
Routing sends people to the wrong place
Reporting does not answer the question

questions.text: What would the front line say if we asked them directly?
What is currently blocking further optimization?
What is the oldest unresolved item, and how long has it been open?
questions.logic: Age of the oldest open item is a better health signal than the count of open items.

questions.text: Is there an escalation open with RingCentral?
Has anything happened that changes the original business case?
Contract renewal date
Likelihood of renewal as things stand:
Interest in capability not yet deployed.
What would have to be true for this customer to expand?
